This repository uses `.github/pull_request_template.md` as the default pull request template.

For control-plane-sensitive work, ensure the PR explicitly covers:

- linked work item or rationale for no issue
- learner-facing or musical-contract behaviour impact
- verification performed
- physical-guitar review requirements
- consistency with `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- whether project state needs updating after merge
